description: Canonical reusable library of already-retargeted Bip001 hero clips. Entries are generated from the baked integrity inventory; games resolve the same baked JSON instead of copying clips.

requiredValidation: verify clip SHA-256 against the integrity inventory
assert Bip001 track family before binding
use weapon skill bindings rather than direct UI clip names

excludes: Mixamo source tracks without an explicit Bip001 retarget bake
FX path data; load those through their skill effect contract
